meta.name: OBDex generic OBD-II dataset
meta.note: Descriptions are independently authored by OBDex; they are not SAE text.

records.titleEn: Driver Frontal Stage 1 Deployment Control
records.descriptionEn: The supplemental restraint system (SRS) module has detected a fault in the deployment control circuit for the first stage of the driver frontal airbag. The SRS warning lamp illuminates and airbag deployment may be impaired in a crash event.

causes.labelEn: Clock spring (spiral cable) damaged in steering column
Loose or corroded airbag connector under steering wheel

symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Driver Frontal Stage 2 Deployment Control
records.descriptionEn: The SRS module has detected a fault in the deployment control circuit for the second stage of the driver frontal airbag. Dual-stage airbags use two charges for severity-dependent deployment — this code indicates the high-severity stage cannot be triggered reliably.

causes.labelEn: Stage 2 squib circuit open or shorted

symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Driver Frontal Deployment Loop Resistance Low
records.descriptionEn: The SRS module has detected that the resistance in the driver frontal airbag deployment loop is below the expected range, suggesting a short or partial short between the squib leads. The airbag warning lamp is illuminated.

causes.labelEn: Shorted squib leads in clock spring or wiring
Internal short within driver airbag module

symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Driver Frontal Deployment Loop Resistance High
records.descriptionEn: The SRS module measured a higher than expected resistance in the driver frontal airbag deployment circuit. Causes include a partially open connection, corroded contacts, or a damaged clock spring conductor.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Driver Frontal Deployment Loop Open
records.descriptionEn: The SRS module detects an open circuit in the driver frontal airbag deployment loop. The airbag will not deploy in a crash and the SRS warning lamp is illuminated.

causes.labelEn: Wiring harness break in steering column

symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Driver Frontal Deployment Loop Short to Ground
records.descriptionEn: One of the deployment leads for the driver frontal airbag is shorted to ground. The SRS module disables deployment of the affected stage to prevent unintended firing.

causes.labelEn: Internal airbag module short to housing

symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Driver Frontal Deployment Loop Short to Battery
records.descriptionEn: The driver frontal airbag deployment loop is shorted to battery voltage. This is potentially dangerous as it could cause unintended deployment; the SRS module isolates the circuit and sets the warning lamp.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Deployment Control
records.descriptionEn: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Deployment Control: the restraints module has detected a fault in this airbag/pretensioner deployment circuit, which may prevent correct deployment in a crash. Safety-critical.

causes.labelEn: Loose or corroded passenger airbag connector

symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Stage 2 Deployment Control
records.descriptionEn: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Stage 2 Deployment Control: the restraints module has detected a fault in this airbag/pretensioner deployment circuit, which may prevent correct deployment in a crash. Safety-critical.

causes.labelEn: Stage 2 squib circuit open or shorted

symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Stage 2 Deployment Control
records.descriptionEn: The SRS module has detected a fault in the second-stage deployment circuit of the front passenger airbag. The dual-stage charge cannot be triggered as designed and the airbag warning lamp is illuminated.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Passenger Knee Bolster Deployment Control
records.descriptionEn: Fault on the deployment control circuit of the passenger knee airbag (knee bolster). Restricts lower-body motion of the passenger in a frontal collision.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Driver Knee Airbag Deployment Control
records.descriptionEn: The SRS module has detected a fault in the driver knee airbag deployment control circuit. The knee airbag may not deploy in a crash event.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Passenger Knee Airbag Deployment Control
records.descriptionEn: The SRS module has detected a fault in the passenger knee airbag deployment control circuit. Same fault profile as B0014 but for the passenger side.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Deployment Loop Short to Ground
records.descriptionEn: The SRS module detected a short to ground in the front passenger airbag deployment circuit. Deployment of the affected stage is inhibited and the warning lamp is illuminated.

causes.labelEn: Water at connector causing low resistance

symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Deployment Loop Short to Battery
records.descriptionEn: The front passenger airbag deployment loop is shorted to battery voltage, creating a risk of unintended deployment. The SRS module disables the circuit and stores this fault.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Deployment Loop Resistance High
records.descriptionEn: The SRS module measures a higher than expected resistance in the passenger frontal deployment loop, indicating partial corrosion or damage. The airbag may not deploy reliably.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Deployment Loop Resistance Low
records.descriptionEn: The SRS module detects too low a resistance in the front passenger airbag deployment loop, suggesting a partial short. Deployment of that stage is inhibited.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Center Frontal Stage 3 Deployment Control
records.descriptionEn: Fault on the deployment circuit of the center frontal airbag, deployment stage 3 (highest severity). Used in dual or triple-stage front airbag systems for severe crash energy.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Left Side Deployment Stage 1 Loop Short to Ground

records.titleEn: Front Crash Sensor Left Communication Lost

records.titleEn: HVAC Mode Door Range/Performance
records.descriptionEn: The HVAC control module has detected that the air distribution mode door (e.g. floor/face/defrost) does not reach the commanded position within the expected time. The actuator may be stuck, the door binding, or the position feedback inaccurate.

causes.labelEn: Wiring or connector fault to actuator

symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Driver Buckle Switch Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The driver seatbelt buckle switch circuit, used to detect whether the belt is fastened, is malfunctioning. The seatbelt warning may be permanently on or off.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Passenger Buckle Switch Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The passenger seatbelt buckle switch circuit is malfunctioning.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Sun Load Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The HVAC control module has detected an implausible signal from the sun load (solar) sensor, typically located on the dashboard. Automatic climate control uses this signal to bias cooling on the side facing the sun.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Ambient Air Temperature Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The HVAC control module has detected an implausible signal from the ambient air temperature sensor used by the climate control system. Symptoms include incorrect outside temperature display and erratic automatic climate behavior.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Outside Temperature Sensor Range/Performance
records.descriptionEn: The HVAC control module reports an out-of-range or implausible reading from the outside air temperature sensor. The displayed value may be stuck or impossibly high/low.

causes.labelEn: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: In-Vehicle Temperature Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The HVAC control module has detected an implausible signal from the in-vehicle temperature sensor — typically an aspirated sensor in the dashboard. Automatic climate control regulates cabin temperature using this signal.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Sun Load Sensor 2 Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The HVAC control module has detected an implausible signal from the second sun load sensor. Dual-zone systems use two solar sensors to detect side-asymmetric sunlight and adjust left/right airflow temperature.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Air Bag In-Vehicle Temperature Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: A fault is detected in the in-vehicle temperature sensor circuit used by the SRS module for deployment compensation.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: HVAC Discharge Air Temperature Sensor
records.descriptionEn: The HVAC control module reports an implausible signal from the discharge (vent outlet) air temperature sensor. This sensor verifies that the actual outlet air temperature matches the commanded value.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: HVAC Air Mix Door Performance
records.descriptionEn: The HVAC control module has detected that the air mix (blend) door does not reach the commanded position within the expected time. The blend door regulates the ratio of air through the heater core versus around it.

causes.labelEn: Blend door mechanically binding or broken

symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: HVAC Mode Door Position Sensor
records.descriptionEn: The HVAC control module reports an implausible position signal from the mode (air distribution) door feedback sensor. Without valid feedback the actuator cannot be regulated to the correct position.

causes.labelEn: Wiring or connector fault to actuator

symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: HVAC Air Inlet Door
records.descriptionEn: The HVAC control module has detected a fault on the fresh-air/recirculation inlet door — typically a stuck actuator or position feedback out of range.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: HVAC Recirculation Door Performance
records.descriptionEn: The HVAC control module has detected that the recirculation door does not reach the commanded position within the expected time. The recirc door switches between fresh air and recirculated cabin air.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Front Blower Motor Circuit Low
records.descriptionEn: The HVAC control module has detected low voltage or a short to ground in the front blower motor circuit. The blower may run too slow or not at all.

causes.labelEn: Blower resistor or power module failed

symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Right Front/Passenger Side Buckle Tension Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The right front buckle tension sensor circuit is reporting a malfunction.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Rear Blower Motor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The HVAC control module has detected a fault in the rear blower motor circuit, used in vehicles with separate rear climate zones. Symptoms include no rear airflow or rear blower stuck on.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Front Blower Motor Speed Performance
records.descriptionEn: The HVAC control module has detected that the front blower motor does not run at the commanded speed. Possible causes include a worn motor, blocked airway, or driver module fault.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Rear Wiper Motor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The body control module has detected a fault in the rear wiper motor circuit. Possible faults include an open or shorted motor winding, a stuck mechanism, or wiring damage in the tailgate harness.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Front Wiper Park Switch Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The body control module has detected a fault in the front wiper park switch circuit. The wipers may not return to the park position when switched off.

causes.labelEn: Park switch in wiper motor failed

symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Front Wiper Speed Performance
records.descriptionEn: The body control module has detected that the front wiper does not run at the commanded speed. Possible causes include a worn motor, binding linkage, or excessive load.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Air Bag System Voltage Out of Range
records.descriptionEn: The SRS module has detected that its supply voltage is outside the operating range, preventing reliable deployment readiness.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: HVAC Defroster Door Position
records.descriptionEn: The HVAC control module has detected that the defroster door (windshield air outlet flap) does not reach the commanded position. Defrosting performance may be reduced.

causes.labelEn: Door actuator motor failed or stripped

symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Rain Sensor Module
records.descriptionEn: The body control module has detected a fault in the rain sensor module on the windshield. Automatic wiper activation based on moisture detection is no longer available.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Front Wiper Motor Speed Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The body control module has detected that the front wiper motor speed feedback does not match the commanded speed. The motor may run only on one speed or not at all.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: SRS Indicator Lamp Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The SRS module has detected a fault in the airbag warning lamp circuit. The lamp may be inoperative, which prevents driver notification of stored faults.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Headlamp Auto-Leveling Front Sensor
records.descriptionEn: The body control module reports an implausible signal from the front ride-height sensor used by the automatic headlamp leveling system. Without valid input, the headlamp pitch cannot be corrected for vehicle load.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Front Fog Lamp Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The body control module has detected a fault in the front fog lamp circuit — typically an open bulb, blown fuse, or wiring fault. One or both fog lamps may not work.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Front Marker Lamp Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The body control module has detected a fault in the front side marker lamp circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state — the bulb may be burned out or the wiring is open.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Rear Tail Lamp Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The body control module has detected a fault in the rear tail lamp circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Brake Lamp Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The body control module has detected a fault in the brake lamp circuit. One or more brake lamps do not match the commanded state — a safety-relevant fault.
symptomsEn: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

records.titleEn: Backup Lamp Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The body control module has detected a fault in the backup (reverse) lamp circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state when reverse gear is engaged.

records.titleEn: ABS Pump Motor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The ABS control module detects an electrical fault in the pump motor circuit. Without a working pump, the system cannot build hydraulic pressure for ABS or stability control interventions and disables those functions.

causes.labelEn: Pump motor seized after long inactivity
Pump motor relay welded or open

records.titleEn: ABS Pump Motor Circuit Range/Performance
records.descriptionEn: The pump motor responds, but its current draw or run time is outside the expected range. The control module suspects mechanical wear or hydraulic blockage.

causes.labelEn: Hydraulic block contaminated with brake fluid debris
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

records.titleEn: ABS Pump Motor Circuit Low
records.descriptionEn: Voltage on the pump motor control line is below threshold. Typical causes are a short to ground or interrupted positive supply.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

records.titleEn: ABS Pump Motor Circuit High
records.descriptionEn: Voltage on the pump motor control line is above the expected range, typically caused by a short to battery voltage or a stuck relay.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

records.titleEn: Brake Pedal Feedback Pressure Solenoid Circuit
records.descriptionEn: Fault on brake pedal feedback pressure solenoid — used in brake-by-wire systems to provide pedal feel.

records.titleEn: ABS Pump Motor Stalled
records.descriptionEn: The pump motor draws current but does not rotate. Self-test detects a stalled rotor and disables ABS and stability control.

records.titleEn: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
records.descriptionEn: The signal from the left front wheel speed sensor is implausible relative to the other wheels. Typical causes are excessive air gap, contaminated tone ring or partial sensor failure.

causes.labelEn: Metal debris on tone ring (magnetic encoder)

records.titleEn: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Low
records.descriptionEn: Voltage on the left front wheel speed sensor circuit is below the expected range. The fault is typically caused by a short to ground or an open in the supply line.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

records.titleEn: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit High
records.descriptionEn: Voltage on the left front wheel speed sensor circuit is above the expected range, typically due to a short to battery voltage.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

records.titleEn: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Signal Erratic
records.descriptionEn: The control module sees erratic pulses from the left front wheel speed sensor at speed. Common cause is metallic debris on a magnetic encoder or a damaged tone ring.

causes.labelEn: Tone ring cracked or missing teeth
Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

records.titleEn: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor No Signal
records.descriptionEn: No pulses are received from the left front wheel speed sensor while other wheels report motion. The fault disables ABS and stability control.

records.titleEn: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the left front wheel speed sensor circuit. Loss of wheel speed information disables ABS and stability control, and a separate ABS warning lamp is illuminated.

causes.labelEn: Tone ring (reluctor) damaged or contaminated with debris
Wiring break or chafe at wheel arch
Wheel hub bearing with integrated sensor ring failed

records.titleEn: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Intermittent
records.descriptionEn: Intermittent open or short detected on the left front wheel speed sensor circuit. Often caused by chafed wiring or a loose connector.

causes.labelEn: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

records.titleEn: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor

records.titleEn: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Supply
records.descriptionEn: Fault on left rear wheel speed sensor supply circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

records.titleEn: Right Rear Tone Wheel

records.titleEn: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor

records.titleEn: Rear Tone Wheel

records.titleEn: Brake Booster Pressure Sensor

records.titleEn: Brake Booster Travel Sensor
records.descriptionEn: Generic fault on brake booster travel/position sensor. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

records.titleEn: Brake Booster Motor A Position Sensor Exceeded Learning Limit

causes.labelEn: Thermal overload from extended ABS use

records.titleEn: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit. Loss of wheel speed information disables ABS and stability control, and a separate ABS warning lamp is illuminated.

causes.labelEn: Wiring break or chafe under chassis
Wheel hub bearing with integrated sensor ring failed

records.titleEn: Power Steering Position Sensor Performance
records.descriptionEn: The chassis or power steering control module has detected that the steering position signal is implausible compared to vehicle motion. Stability control may be limited because correct yaw and slip-angle calculation depends on a valid steering angle.

causes.labelEn: Steering angle sensor not calibrated after alignment or repair
Signal path through clock spring degraded

records.titleEn: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Low
records.descriptionEn: Voltage in the left rear wheel speed sensor circuit is below the expected range. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

records.titleEn: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit High
records.descriptionEn: Voltage in the left rear wheel speed sensor circuit is above the expected range. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

records.titleEn: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Signal Erratic
records.descriptionEn: Erratic pulses from the left rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.labelEn: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

records.titleEn: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor No Signal
records.descriptionEn: No pulses received from the left rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

records.titleEn: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Intermittent
records.descriptionEn: Intermittent open or short on the left rear wheel speed sensor circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.labelEn: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

records.titleEn: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The ABS control module detects a fault in the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit. ABS and stability control are deactivated.

records.titleEn: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
records.descriptionEn: The right rear wheel speed signal is implausible compared to the other wheels. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.labelEn: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

records.titleEn: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Low
records.descriptionEn: Voltage in the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit is below the expected range. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

records.titleEn: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit High
records.descriptionEn: Voltage in the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit is above the expected range. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

records.titleEn: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Signal Erratic
records.descriptionEn: Erratic pulses from the right rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.labelEn: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

records.titleEn: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor No Signal
records.descriptionEn: No pulses received from the right rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

records.titleEn: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Intermittent
records.descriptionEn: Intermittent open or short on the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.labelEn: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

records.titleEn: Yaw Rate/Longitude Sensors
records.descriptionEn: Generic fault on yaw rate/longitudinal acceleration sensor cluster.

records.titleEn: Multi-axis Acceleration Sensor
records.descriptionEn: Generic fault on multi-axis acceleration sensor (combines lateral, longitudinal and vertical accelerations).

records.titleEn: Stability System Active Too Long
records.descriptionEn: Electronic stability control intervened for an excessive duration.

causes.labelEn: Extended intervention from low traction or driver behavior

records.titleEn: Stability System
records.descriptionEn: Generic fault in electronic stability control system.

records.titleEn: Vehicle Speed Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The chassis controller detects a fault in the dedicated vehicle speed sensor circuit (when present in addition to wheel speed sensors).

records.titleEn: 2/4 Wheel Drive Status Input
records.descriptionEn: Fault on 2WD/4WD status signal input.

records.titleEn: Brake Temperature Too High
records.descriptionEn: Brake temperature exceeded safe operating limit — risk of brake fade.

causes.labelEn: Hard or prolonged braking, mountain descent

records.titleEn: Delivered Driving Torque
records.descriptionEn: Engine-delivered driving torque does not match TCS request.

records.titleEn: Requested Driving Torque
records.descriptionEn: Driving torque request from TCS rejected or out of range.

records.titleEn: Brake Pedal Position Performance
records.descriptionEn: Brake pedal position sensor reading implausible.

records.titleEn: PWM for Traction Control
records.descriptionEn: PWM communication signal for traction control faulty.

records.titleEn: Low Tire Pressure
records.descriptionEn: Tire pressure monitoring system detected low tire pressure.

records.titleEn: Tire Diameter
records.descriptionEn: Detected wheel speed implies tire diameter outside expected range — typically wrong tire size or mismatched tires.

records.titleEn: Variable Effort Steering
records.descriptionEn: Generic fault on variable effort steering (VES) system.

records.titleEn: Wheel Speed Mismatch (Front Axle)
records.descriptionEn: Front axle wheel speeds differ beyond the plausibility threshold over time. Often caused by mismatched tyre rolling circumference or a partially failing sensor.

causes.labelEn: Mixed tyre sizes or worn tyre on one side

records.titleEn: Wheel Speed Mismatch (Rear Axle)
records.descriptionEn: Rear axle wheel speeds differ beyond the plausibility threshold. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

records.titleEn: Brake System Malfunction Indicator
records.descriptionEn: Brake system malfunction indicator circuit fault.

records.titleEn: Tire Pressure Monitor Malfunction Indicator
records.descriptionEn: TPMS malfunction indicator circuit fault.

records.titleEn: Traction Active Indicator
records.descriptionEn: Traction control active indicator lamp circuit fault.

records.titleEn: Traction Disable Indicator
records.descriptionEn: Traction control disable indicator lamp circuit fault.

records.titleEn: Vehicle Dynamics Indicator
records.descriptionEn: Vehicle dynamics control indicator lamp circuit fault.

records.titleEn: TCS Disable Switch
records.descriptionEn: Fault on TCS disable switch.

records.titleEn: TCS Mode Control
records.descriptionEn: Fault on TCS mode control input (offroad/sport mode etc.).

records.titleEn: Hydraulic Brake Pressure Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The brake pressure sensor in the master cylinder or hydraulic block reports an implausible signal or no signal. The fault disables ABS, stability control and brake assist.

records.titleEn: Hydraulic Brake Pressure Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
records.descriptionEn: The brake pressure sensor signal is outside the plausibility band relative to pedal application. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

causes.labelEn: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Power Transfer Unit Position Sensor B
records.descriptionEn: Fault on 4WD/AWD power transfer unit (PTU) position sensor B.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Power Transfer Unit Temperature Sensor
records.descriptionEn: Fault on PTU temperature sensor.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Temperature Sensor
records.descriptionEn: Fault on rear differential unit temperature sensor.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A
records.descriptionEn: Fault on rear differential unit actuator A.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Data
records.descriptionEn: Rear differential actuator A data implausible or out of range.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B
records.descriptionEn: Fault on rear differential unit actuator B.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Data
records.descriptionEn: Rear differential actuator B data implausible or out of range.

records.titleEn: ABS Control Module Internal Fault
records.descriptionEn: The ABS control module fails its internal self-test (RAM, ROM or processor watchdog). ABS and stability control are disabled.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Position Sensor B
records.descriptionEn: Fault on rear differential actuator A position sensor B.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Position Sensor C
records.descriptionEn: Fault on rear differential actuator A position sensor C.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Position Sensor Correlation
records.descriptionEn: Position sensors on rear differential actuator A disagree.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Position Sensor A
records.descriptionEn: Fault on rear differential actuator B position sensor A.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Position Sensor B
records.descriptionEn: Fault on rear differential actuator B position sensor B.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Position Sensor C
records.descriptionEn: Fault on rear differential actuator B position sensor C.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Position Sensor Correlation
records.descriptionEn: Position sensors on rear differential actuator B disagree.

records.titleEn: Driveline Control Module
records.descriptionEn: Generic fault on driveline control module.

records.titleEn: Driveline Control Module Power Transfer Unit Control Circuit Driver
records.descriptionEn: Fault on driveline control module driver for PTU control circuit.

records.titleEn: Driveline Control Module Rear Differential Unit A Control Circuit Driver
records.descriptionEn: Fault on driveline control module driver for rear differential unit A.

records.titleEn: Driveline Control Module Rear Differential Unit B Control Circuit Driver
records.descriptionEn: Fault on driveline control module driver for rear differential unit B.

records.titleEn: Driveline Control Module Transfer Case Unit Control Circuit Driver
records.descriptionEn: Fault on driveline control module driver for transfer case unit.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Transfer Case Unit Actuator
records.descriptionEn: Fault on transfer case unit actuator.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Transfer Case Unit Actuator Position Sensor A
records.descriptionEn: Fault on transfer case actuator position sensor A.

records.titleEn: 4WD/AWD Transfer Case Unit Actuator Position Sensor B
records.descriptionEn: Fault on transfer case actuator position sensor B.

records.titleEn: ABS Pump Motor Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the hydraulic pump motor circuit. The pump rebuilds brake pressure during ABS regulation — without it, ABS and stability control are disabled.

causes.labelEn: ABS pump motor failed (worn brushes, seized)
Power supply wiring or fuse fault

records.titleEn: ABS Activation Excessively Long
records.descriptionEn: ABS regulation has been active longer than the allowed duration during a single brake event, suggesting a sensor or hydraulic problem.

records.titleEn: ABS Activation Frequency Too High
records.descriptionEn: ABS regulation cycles activate more frequently than the plausibility model allows.

records.titleEn: Valve Relay Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the valve relay circuit, which supplies power to the ABS solenoid valves. With this fault, the module cannot energize the valves and ABS is disabled.

causes.labelEn: Power supply wiring or fuse fault

records.titleEn: Low Brake Fluid Indicated
records.descriptionEn: The brake fluid level switch in the master cylinder reservoir reports a low level. ABS and stability control may be deactivated as a precaution.

causes.labelEn: Worn brake pads (fluid drops as pistons extend)

records.titleEn: Master Cylinder Pressure Sensor Range/Performance
records.descriptionEn: The ABS or stability control module has detected an implausible signal from the master cylinder brake pressure sensor. This sensor reports driver brake input and is used by ABS and ESP for control decisions.

causes.labelEn: Air in brake system causing erratic pressure

records.titleEn: Stop Lamp Switch Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The ABS or stability control module sees an implausible brake light switch signal. Stability and brake assist functions can be limited until the fault is cleared.

records.titleEn: Left Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit
records.descriptionEn: Left Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

causes.labelEn: Inlet solenoid coil open or shorted

records.titleEn: Left Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit
records.descriptionEn: Left Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

causes.labelEn: Outlet solenoid coil open or shorted

records.titleEn: Right Front ABS Outlet Solenoid B Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The ABS module has detected an electrical fault in the secondary outlet solenoid for the right front wheel. ABS and stability control are disabled while the fault is active.

causes.labelEn: Outlet solenoid valve failed (open or shorted)
Internal fault in ABS hydraulic unit

records.titleEn: Right Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit
records.descriptionEn: Right Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

causes.labelEn: Inlet solenoid coil open or shorted

records.titleEn: Right Front ABS Inlet Solenoid B Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: Electrical fault in the secondary inlet solenoid for the right front wheel. Pressure modulation for that wheel is no longer possible and ABS is disabled.

records.titleEn: Right Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit
records.descriptionEn: Right Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

causes.labelEn: Outlet solenoid coil open or shorted

records.titleEn: Left Rear ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: Electrical fault in the inlet solenoid for the left rear wheel. ABS is disabled and the warning lamp is illuminated.

records.titleEn: ABS/TCS Brake Switch Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The ABS or traction control module has detected an implausible signal from the brake light switch. The switch tells the module whether the driver is braking and is used to inhibit traction control during braking.

causes.labelEn: Brake light switch failed or misadjusted

records.titleEn: Left Rear ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: Electrical fault in the outlet solenoid for the left rear wheel. ABS pressure release for this wheel is no longer possible.

records.titleEn: Right Rear ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: Electrical fault in the inlet solenoid for the right rear wheel. ABS is disabled while the fault is active.

records.titleEn: Right Rear ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: Electrical fault in the outlet solenoid for the right rear wheel. ABS pressure release for this wheel is no longer possible.

records.titleEn: Lateral Acceleration Sensor Range/Performance
records.descriptionEn: The stability control module has detected that the lateral acceleration sensor signal is out of the expected range or does not match other inertial sensors. ESP and roll-stability functions may be disabled.

causes.labelEn: Lateral acceleration sensor failed or drifted
Sensor mounting loose or misaligned after body repair

records.titleEn: Lateral Acceleration Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The stability control module has detected an implausible signal from the lateral acceleration sensor. ESP uses lateral g-force together with yaw rate and steering angle to detect skid conditions — without it, ESP is disabled.

causes.labelEn: Sensor cluster loose or mounted incorrectly

records.titleEn: Yaw Rate Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The stability control module has detected an implausible signal from the yaw rate sensor. The yaw sensor measures rotation around the vertical axis and is essential for ESP — a fault disables stability control.

causes.labelEn: Sensor not calibrated after replacement or alignment

records.titleEn: ABS Solenoid Valve Front Left Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The ABS control module detects a fault in the inlet/outlet solenoid for the front left brake circuit. The valve is integrated in the hydraulic block; replacement is generally a workshop task.

causes.labelEn: Internal short to ground in valve block

records.titleEn: Brake Fluid Level Switch Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The ABS or brake control module has detected a fault in the brake fluid level switch circuit. A low fluid level indicates a potential leak in the hydraulic system and disables ABS while a separate brake warning lamp is illuminated.

causes.labelEn: Brake fluid level low (worn pads or hydraulic leak)

records.titleEn: Brake Pedal Position Sensor
records.descriptionEn: The chassis or brake control module has detected an implausible signal from the brake pedal position sensor. Modern brake systems use this sensor for brake assist, regenerative braking and adaptive cruise control functions.

records.titleEn: ABS Solenoid Valve Front Right Circuit
records.descriptionEn: Fault in the front right ABS solenoid (mirror of C0200).

records.titleEn: Stop Lamp Switch Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The ABS or stability control module has detected a fault in the stop lamp switch circuit. The brake light switch tells the module whether the driver is braking and is used to coordinate ABS, traction control and cruise control.

causes.labelEn: Stop lamp switch failed or misadjusted

records.titleEn: ABS Solenoid Valve Rear Left Circuit
records.descriptionEn: Fault in the rear left ABS solenoid valve.

records.titleEn: ABS Solenoid Valve Rear Right Circuit
records.descriptionEn: Fault in the rear right ABS solenoid valve.

records.titleEn: ABS Valve Block Supply Voltage
records.descriptionEn: Supply voltage to the ABS valve block is out of range, disabling all valve control.

records.titleEn: ABS Valve Relay Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The valve relay supplying the ABS solenoids does not respond as commanded.

records.titleEn: Brake Pedal Position Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The brake pedal position sensor reports an implausible signal. Required for brake-by-wire and stability control.

records.titleEn: Wheel Speed Sensor Frequency Error
records.descriptionEn: The ABS control module has detected that one of the wheel speed sensor signals has a frequency outside the plausible range, e.g. unrealistically high pulses or signal dropouts at speed. Stability control may be limited.

causes.labelEn: Tone ring damaged, missing teeth, or contaminated

records.titleEn: Wheel Speed Sensor Signal Erratic
records.descriptionEn: The ABS control module has detected an erratic wheel speed sensor signal — sudden jumps or dropouts compared to the other wheels. Typical causes are a damaged tone ring or a loose sensor.

causes.labelEn: Tone ring damaged or contaminated with metal debris
Wheel speed sensor loose in housing

records.titleEn: Loss of Speed Sensor Signal Front Left
records.descriptionEn: The ABS control module has lost the wheel speed signal from the front left wheel during driving. ABS and stability control are disabled because wheel-individual speed information is required for slip detection.

records.titleEn: Speed Wheel-to-Wheel Mismatch
records.descriptionEn: The ABS control module has detected an implausible speed difference between wheels that cannot be explained by cornering. This typically points to one suspect sensor, mismatched tyre sizes or a damaged tone ring.

causes.labelEn: Tyre sizes or wear levels do not match across axles
Tone ring missing teeth on one wheel

records.titleEn: Brake Pressure Sensor
records.descriptionEn: The ABS or stability control module has detected a fault in a brake pressure sensor. Pressure information is used by ESP and brake assist to determine driver intent and modulation pressure during regulation.

records.titleEn: ABS Warning Lamp Control Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The ABS warning lamp control circuit is shorted or open. The driver may see a permanently lit or non-functional ABS warning lamp.

records.titleEn: PCM Indicated ABS Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The powertrain control module reports a fault that the ABS module must consider (e.g. traction control engine torque request fault).

records.titleEn: PWM Brake Pressure Modulation Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The PWM control of the brake pressure modulation valves is faulty.

records.titleEn: Wheel Speed Sensor Frequency Mismatch
records.descriptionEn: The ABS control module has detected that the frequency of one wheel speed sensor signal does not match the others under stable driving conditions. This often indicates a tone ring with extra or missing teeth or a sensor with degraded signal quality.

records.titleEn: ABS/TCS Control Module Internal Performance
records.descriptionEn: Internal plausibility check of the combined ABS/TCS control module fails.

records.titleEn: Power Steering Pump Pressure
records.descriptionEn: The power steering control module has detected an implausible pressure or load signal from the steering pump. On hydraulic systems this may indicate low fluid or a worn pump; on electric systems it may indicate excessive motor load.

causes.labelEn: Power steering fluid low or contaminated

records.titleEn: Pump Motor Ground Circuit Open
records.descriptionEn: The pump motor ground return is open. The motor cannot run, and the system disables ABS and stability control.

causes.labelEn: Pin pushed back out of connector body

records.titleEn: Brake Booster Vacuum Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The brake booster vacuum sensor reports an implausible signal; brake assist functions are reduced. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

records.titleEn: EBCM Relay Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The Electronic Brake Control Module has detected a fault in its main supply relay circuit. Without proper relay supply the EBCM cannot operate the hydraulic unit and ABS as well as stability control are disabled.

causes.labelEn: Power supply wiring or fuse fault

records.titleEn: Active Brake Booster
records.descriptionEn: The brake control module has detected a fault in the active (electric or vacuum-controlled) brake booster. Active boosters are used by emergency brake assist and adaptive cruise control to autonomously build brake pressure.

causes.labelEn: Active booster motor or solenoid failed
Vacuum supply weak (vacuum pump or hose fault)

records.titleEn: Brake Pump Motor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The ABS or brake control module has detected an electrical fault in the brake pump motor circuit. The pump is used to build brake pressure during ABS, ESP and brake-by-wire operations and a fault disables these functions.

records.titleEn: Brake Pump Run Time Exceeded
records.descriptionEn: The brake control module has detected that the brake pump has run longer than the allowed maximum time. This typically indicates the pump cannot reach target pressure due to a hydraulic leak, air in the system or a worn pump.

records.titleEn: Brake Vacuum Sensor
records.descriptionEn: The brake control module has detected an implausible signal from the vacuum sensor on the brake booster. Modern systems monitor booster vacuum to ensure brake assist is available, especially with stop-start engines and electric vacuum pumps.

records.titleEn: Brake Booster Pressure Sensor Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The brake control module has detected an out-of-range or implausible signal from the brake booster pressure sensor. Brake assist and electronic boost functions may be limited.

causes.labelEn: Wiring or connector fault to sensor

records.titleEn: Brake Booster Vacuum Sensor Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The brake control module has detected an implausible signal from the booster vacuum sensor. Loss of vacuum signal can cause hard pedal and reduced power assist.

causes.labelEn: Vacuum leak in booster or hose

records.titleEn: Brake Booster Boost Sensor Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The brake control module has detected an electrical fault in the booster boost (assist pressure) sensor circuit. Power-assist regulation may default to a backup strategy.

records.titleEn: ESP Performance
records.descriptionEn: The stability control module has detected that overall ESP performance is degraded — typically a plausibility check between yaw rate, lateral acceleration, steering angle and wheel speeds has failed. ESP is deactivated until the root cause is resolved.

causes.labelEn: Sensor cluster loose or mounted incorrectly

records.titleEn: Yaw Rate Sensor Range
records.descriptionEn: The stability control module has detected that the yaw rate sensor signal is outside the plausible range during stable driving. This typically indicates a sensor offset, an incorrect mounting or a degraded sensor element.

records.titleEn: Brake Pedal Stroke Sensor Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The brake control module has detected an out-of-range signal from the brake pedal stroke sensor. Pedal travel information is required for brake assist and electronically boosted braking.

causes.labelEn: Sensor mounting or pedal linkage misadjusted

records.titleEn: Brake Pedal Apply Sensor Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: Electrical fault in the brake pedal apply sensor circuit. The module cannot reliably detect whether the brake pedal is pressed, which affects ABS, ESP and brake assist functions.

records.titleEn: Steering Sensor Indicates Bias
records.descriptionEn: The stability control module has detected that the steering wheel position sensor reports a non-zero angle when the vehicle is driving straight. This bias makes ESP intervene incorrectly and the system requires recalibration.

records.titleEn: Inlet Valve Front Left Performance
records.descriptionEn: The front left inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected during ABS self-test.

causes.labelEn: Valve stuck due to brake fluid debris

records.titleEn: Air Suspension Compressor Relay
records.descriptionEn: The air suspension control module has detected a fault in the compressor relay circuit. The compressor cannot be energized which prevents the system from refilling the air struts and ride height drops over time.

records.titleEn: Outlet Valve Front Left Performance
records.descriptionEn: The front left outlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

records.titleEn: Inlet Valve Front Right Performance
records.descriptionEn: The front right inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

records.titleEn: Outlet Valve Front Right Performance
records.descriptionEn: The front right outlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

records.titleEn: Inlet Valve Rear Left Performance
records.descriptionEn: The rear left inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

records.titleEn: Ride Height Sensor Front Left
records.descriptionEn: Ride Height Sensor Front Left: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

records.titleEn: Inlet Valve Rear Right Performance
records.descriptionEn: The rear right inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

records.titleEn: Ride Height Sensor Front Right
records.descriptionEn: Ride Height Sensor Front Right: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

records.titleEn: Outlet Valve Rear Right Performance
records.descriptionEn: The rear right outlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

records.titleEn: Ride Height Sensor Rear Left
records.descriptionEn: Ride Height Sensor Rear Left: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

records.titleEn: Ride Height Sensor Rear Right
records.descriptionEn: Ride Height Sensor Rear Right: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

records.titleEn: Compressor Relay Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The air suspension control module has detected a circuit fault on the compressor relay output — typically open circuit, short to ground or short to power. Self-levelling is disabled and the vehicle may sit lower than normal.

causes.labelEn: Compressor motor shorted, dragging supply down

records.titleEn: Encoder Motor
records.descriptionEn: The transfer case control module has detected a fault in the encoder motor used to shift between 2WD and 4WD ranges. A fault prevents range changes and may leave the transfer case in an undefined position.

causes.labelEn: Encoder motor failed (worn brushes or seized)

records.titleEn: 4WD Drive Coupling
records.descriptionEn: The 4WD or AWD control module has detected a fault on the electronic drive coupling that distributes torque between axles. Reduced torque transfer or a complete loss of all-wheel drive function may result.

records.titleEn: Front Axle Disconnect
records.descriptionEn: The 4WD control module has detected a fault on the front axle disconnect actuator. On part-time AWD vehicles this actuator decouples the front axle for fuel saving, and a fault prevents engagement or disengagement of front-wheel drive.

records.titleEn: Transfer Case Position Sensor
records.descriptionEn: The transfer case control module has detected an implausible signal from the position sensor that reports the current shift position (2HI, 4HI, 4LO, neutral). Without a valid position the system cannot complete a range change.

records.titleEn: Transfer Case High Range Switch Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The transfer case control module has detected an implausible state from the high range (4H) position switch. Range selection in 4WD mode may be limited.

records.titleEn: Transfer Case Low Range Switch Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The transfer case control module has detected an implausible state from the low range (4L) position switch. Engagement of low range may be inhibited.

records.titleEn: 4WD Mode Switch Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The transfer case or 4WD control module has detected an invalid signal from the driver-operated 4WD mode selector. Mode requests from the dashboard may be ignored.

records.titleEn: Traction Control Solenoid Valve Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The dedicated traction control isolation valve in the hydraulic block reports an electrical fault.

records.titleEn: Traction Control Switch Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The TCS on/off switch reports an implausible state.

records.titleEn: Traction Control Lamp Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The TCS indicator lamp control circuit is shorted or open.

records.titleEn: Traction Control Active Too Long
records.descriptionEn: TCS regulation has been continuously active longer than allowed, suggesting persistent low-friction conditions or a sensor fault.

records.titleEn: Adaptive Cruise Control Sensor Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The adaptive cruise control module has detected a fault in its forward-looking radar or lidar sensor circuit. ACC and forward collision warning are unavailable while the fault is active.

causes.labelEn: Radar sensor blocked by snow, ice or dirt

records.titleEn: Adaptive Cruise Control Module Internal Performance
records.descriptionEn: The adaptive cruise control module has reported an internal performance fault — for example self-test failure, supply voltage out of range or invalid configuration. ACC is disabled.

causes.labelEn: Module configuration invalid after part exchange

records.titleEn: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The steering angle sensor reports an electrical fault. ESC and lane keeping assistance functions are typically disabled.

records.titleEn: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Calibration
records.descriptionEn: The steering angle sensor has not been calibrated after a service operation, or the calibration value is implausible.

records.titleEn: Rear Wheel Steering Position Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: On vehicles with active rear wheel steering, the rear position sensor reports an electrical fault. The system disables rear steering.

records.titleEn: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The chassis or stability control module has detected a fault in the steering wheel position sensor circuit. ESP and lane assist systems require an accurate steering angle and may be deactivated.

records.titleEn: Steering Position Signal Implausible
records.descriptionEn: Steering angle signal is implausible compared with yaw rate, lateral acceleration and wheel speeds.

records.titleEn: Yaw Rate Sensor Circuit

records.titleEn: Brake Pressure Sensor C Circuit Range/Performance
records.descriptionEn: Brake pressure sensor C reading implausible. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

causes.labelEn: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

records.titleEn: Park Brake Actuator Position Signal Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The EPB module has detected an out-of-range position signal from a caliper actuator. The module cannot determine whether the brake is fully applied or released.

records.titleEn: Brake Pressure Sensor D Circuit High
records.descriptionEn: Brake pressure sensor D signal voltage above expected range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance
Supply wire pinched against B+ source

records.titleEn: Park Brake Force Sensor Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The EPB module has detected an electrical fault in the clamp-force sensor circuit. Without this signal, regulated clamping force cannot be ensured and a fallback strategy is used.

records.titleEn: Park Brake Switch Stuck Open
records.descriptionEn: The EPB module has detected that the park brake operator switch remains in the open (released) state when an apply request is expected. Operation of the EPB by the driver is restricted.

causes.labelEn: Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement

records.titleEn: Brake Booster Temperature Sensor B Circuit Low
