records.titleEn: Service/Park Brake Chamber Pressure Sensor
records.descriptionEn: Generic fault on service/park brake chamber pressure sensor — used on air-brake systems with combined service and spring-applied parking brake chamber.

records.titleEn: Service/Park Brake Chamber Pressure Too High
records.descriptionEn: Pressure in the service/park brake chamber exceeded safe limit.

records.titleEn: Service/Park Brake Chamber Pressure Too Low
records.descriptionEn: Pressure in the service/park brake chamber dropped below required minimum — risk of insufficient braking force.

records.titleEn: Electric Park Brake Actuator Left Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The left electric park brake caliper actuator does not respond as commanded.

records.titleEn: Electric Park Brake Actuator Right Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The right electric park brake caliper actuator does not respond as commanded.

records.titleEn: Electric Park Brake Module Internal Fault
records.descriptionEn: The EPB control module fails its internal self-test and the park brake function may be limited.

records.titleEn: Active Steering Module Communication
records.descriptionEn: A communication fault between the chassis control module and the active steering module has been detected. Active steering varies the steering ratio with speed, and a fault disables this assistance and may store secondary codes in other modules.

causes.labelEn: Power supply or ground fault to module

records.titleEn: Steering Position Signal Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The chassis or stability control module has received an invalid or missing steering position signal — often via the communication bus from the steering control module. ESP, lane assist and electric power steering may be limited.

causes.labelEn: Steering angle sensor or steering control module failed

records.titleEn: Power Steering Position Sensor Range/Performance
records.descriptionEn: The power steering control module has detected that the rack or column position signal is out of range or implausible. Steering assist may be reduced.

causes.labelEn: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

records.titleEn: Power Steering Pressure Sensor Range/Performance
records.descriptionEn: The power steering module has detected that the hydraulic pressure sensor signal is out of range — relevant for hydraulic and electro-hydraulic systems. Assist regulation may run in fallback mode.

causes.labelEn: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

records.titleEn: Electric Power Steering Torque Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The torque sensor in the EPS column or rack reports an electrical fault. Power assist is reduced or disabled.

records.titleEn: Electric Power Steering Motor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The EPS assist motor circuit reports an electrical fault.

causes.labelEn: Short to ground in motor wiring

records.titleEn: Trailer Connector Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The chassis or trailer brake module has detected a fault in the trailer wiring connector — for example open lighting circuit or short to ground. Trailer brake and lighting functions may be unavailable.

causes.labelEn: Short or open in trailer wiring

records.titleEn: Electric Power Steering Motor Position Sensor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The EPS motor position sensor (resolver/Hall) reports an implausible or missing signal.

records.titleEn: Electric Power Steering Module Internal Fault
records.descriptionEn: The EPS control module fails its internal self-test. Power assist is disabled.

records.titleEn: Electric Power Steering Voltage Supply
records.descriptionEn: The supply voltage to the EPS module is out of range, reducing or disabling power assist.

causes.labelEn: Battery undervoltage during high steering load

records.titleEn: Electric Power Steering Overtemperature Protection
records.descriptionEn: The EPS module has reduced or disabled assistance to protect the motor from overheating, typically after extended low-speed manoeuvring.

records.titleEn: Cruise Control Brake Switch
records.descriptionEn: The cruise control or chassis module has detected an implausible signal from the dedicated cruise control brake switch. This switch is independent from the stop lamp switch and disengages cruise control when the driver brakes.

causes.labelEn: Cruise control brake switch failed or misadjusted

records.titleEn: Trailer Brake Force Sensor Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The integrated trailer brake controller has detected an electrical fault in the brake force sensor circuit. Proportional trailer brake control is disabled — the controller defaults to a manual or fixed-gain mode.

records.titleEn: Drive System Voltage Low
records.descriptionEn: The chassis control module has detected that the supply voltage is below the operating threshold required for ABS, ESP or steering systems. Many chassis functions are limited or disabled until the voltage returns to a normal range.

records.titleEn: Steering Angle Sensor Calibration
records.descriptionEn: The chassis or stability control module reports that the steering angle sensor has not been calibrated or that the calibration data has been lost. ESP requires a calibrated zero position and is disabled until calibration is performed.

causes.labelEn: Calibration required after battery disconnect or repair

records.titleEn: Air Suspension Compressor Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The air suspension compressor motor circuit reports an electrical fault. Levelling is disabled.

records.titleEn: Air Suspension Compressor Overtemperature
records.descriptionEn: The air suspension compressor has been disabled to protect against overheating, typically after a slow leak.

causes.labelEn: Slow leak in air spring or line

records.titleEn: Air Suspension Height Sensor Front Left
records.descriptionEn: The front left ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

records.titleEn: Air Suspension Height Sensor Front Right
records.descriptionEn: The front right ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

records.titleEn: Air Suspension Height Sensor Rear Left
records.descriptionEn: The rear left ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

records.titleEn: Air Suspension Height Sensor Rear Right
records.descriptionEn: The rear right ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

records.titleEn: Steering Effort Sensor Range/Performance
records.descriptionEn: The electric power steering module has detected that the torque (effort) sensor signal is out of the expected range. Steering assist is reduced or disabled.

causes.labelEn: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

records.titleEn: Steering Effort Sensor Stuck
records.descriptionEn: The power steering module has detected that the torque sensor signal does not change despite steering input — the sensor appears stuck. Assist is disabled to avoid uncontrolled steering torque.

records.titleEn: Steering Wheel Angle Sensor Center Position Not Learned
records.descriptionEn: The chassis control module has not stored a valid center (zero) position for the steering wheel angle sensor. ESP, lane assist and electric power steering may be limited until calibration is performed.

causes.labelEn: Sensor calibration not performed after replacement

records.titleEn: Air Suspension Solenoid Valve Circuit
records.descriptionEn: One of the level control solenoid valves reports an electrical fault. The corresponding axle cannot be levelled.

records.titleEn: Active Damping Control Front Left
records.descriptionEn: The front left adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

records.titleEn: Active Damping Control Front Right
records.descriptionEn: The front right adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

records.titleEn: Active Damping Control Rear Left
records.descriptionEn: The rear left adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

records.titleEn: Active Damping Control Rear Right
records.descriptionEn: The rear right adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

records.titleEn: Trailer Stability Assist Performance
records.descriptionEn: The trailer stability assist function detects implausible trailer sway response or sensor input.

records.titleEn: Adaptive Cruise Control Brake Request Performance
records.descriptionEn: A brake request from adaptive cruise control or AEB cannot be executed within the expected response time.

causes.labelEn: Hydraulic block slow to build pressure

records.titleEn: TPMS Sensor 1 Battery
records.descriptionEn: TPMS Sensor 1 Battery: the control module has detected this fault condition.

causes.labelEn: TPMS sensor battery depleted (end of life)

records.titleEn: TPMS Sensor 1 Position Performance
records.descriptionEn: The tire pressure monitoring receiver cannot reliably localize sensor 1 to a wheel position. Pressure values may be assigned to the wrong wheel until relearn is completed.

records.titleEn: TPMS Sensor 2 Battery
records.descriptionEn: TPMS Sensor 2 Battery: the control module has detected this fault condition.

causes.labelEn: TPMS sensor battery depleted (end of life)

records.titleEn: TPMS Sensor 2 Position Performance
records.descriptionEn: The tire pressure monitoring receiver cannot reliably localize sensor 2 to a wheel position. Pressure values may be assigned to the wrong wheel until relearn is completed.

records.titleEn: TPMS Sensor 3 Battery Low
records.descriptionEn: The TPMS receiver reports that the internal battery of sensor 3 is at end of life. The sensor must be replaced as the battery is sealed inside the housing.

records.titleEn: TPMS Sensor 4 Battery Low
records.descriptionEn: The TPMS receiver reports that the internal battery of sensor 4 is at end of life. The sensor must be replaced as the battery is sealed inside the housing.

records.titleEn: TPMS Receiver Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The body or chassis module has detected a fault in the TPMS RF receiver — for example open antenna or internal failure. No tire pressure data can be received.

records.titleEn: TPMS Initiator Front Circuit Malfunction
records.descriptionEn: The TPMS module has detected an electrical fault in the front low-frequency initiator (used to wake and locate sensors). Position learning of the front sensors fails.

records.titleEn: Active Roll Stabilisation Front Actuator Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The front active anti-roll bar actuator reports an electrical fault.

records.titleEn: Active Roll Stabilisation Rear Actuator Circuit
records.descriptionEn: The rear active anti-roll bar actuator reports an electrical fault.

records.titleEn: Suspension Control Module Internal Fault
records.descriptionEn: The suspension control module fails its internal self-test. Adaptive damping or air suspension is disabled.

records.titleEn: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Front Left
records.descriptionEn: The TPMS sensor at the front left wheel does not transmit a valid signal. Indirect TPMS variants raise this when the wheel-speed-based estimation fails for that wheel.

records.titleEn: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Front Right
records.descriptionEn: The TPMS sensor at the front right wheel does not transmit a valid signal.

records.titleEn: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Rear Left
records.descriptionEn: The TPMS sensor at the rear left wheel does not transmit a valid signal.

records.titleEn: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Rear Right
records.descriptionEn: The TPMS sensor at the rear right wheel does not transmit a valid signal.

records.titleEn: Tire Pressure Monitoring Module Internal Fault
records.descriptionEn: The tire pressure monitoring module fails its internal self-test.

records.titleEn: Fuel Volume Regulator A Control Circuit/Open
records.descriptionEn: The ECU detects an open circuit in the control of fuel volume regulator A (often the metering valve on the high-pressure fuel pump). The actuator does not respond, so rail pressure cannot be controlled accurately.

records.titleEn: Fuel Volume Regulator A Control Circuit Range/Performance
records.descriptionEn: The control signal of fuel volume regulator A is electrically present but the actual rail pressure does not follow the target value within tolerance. Indicates a mechanical or hydraulic issue rather than pure wiring.

causes.labelEn: High-pressure pump worn or leaking internally

records.titleEn: Fuel Volume Regulator A Control Circuit Low
records.descriptionEn: The ECU sees the control voltage of fuel volume regulator A pulled below the expected range, typically a short to ground or a low-resistance fault in the wiring or coil.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

records.titleEn: Fuel Volume Regulator A Control Circuit High
records.descriptionEn: The ECU sees the control voltage of fuel volume regulator A above the expected range, typically a short to power or open ground return.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

records.titleEn: Fuel Shutoff Valve A Control Circuit/Open
records.descriptionEn: Open circuit detected at the fuel shutoff valve A solenoid (used on diesels to stop fuel flow at engine-off and as anti-theft). Engine may not start or not stop cleanly.

causes.labelEn: Pin pushed back out of connector body

records.titleEn: Fuel Shutoff Valve A Control Circuit Low
records.descriptionEn: Control voltage of fuel shutoff valve A is below the expected range, typically caused by a short to ground or low-resistance fault in the solenoid circuit.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

records.titleEn: Fuel Shutoff Valve A Control Circuit High
records.descriptionEn: Control voltage of fuel shutoff valve A is above the expected range, typically caused by a short to power or open ground return.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

records.titleEn: Engine Position System Performance Bank 1
records.descriptionEn: The ECU detects an implausible relationship between crankshaft and camshaft signals on bank 1, indicating timing chain stretch, jumped tooth, or sensor reluctor wear.

records.titleEn: Engine Position System Performance Bank 2
records.descriptionEn: Same fault pattern as P0008 but on bank 2 of a V or boxer engine. Crank/cam correlation outside spec on the second cylinder bank.

causes.labelEn: Chain jumped one tooth on bank 2

records.titleEn: A Camshaft Position Slow Response Bank 1
records.descriptionEn: The intake camshaft phaser on bank 1 responds too slowly to commanded position changes. Often caused by VVT solenoid sticking, oil aging, or low oil pressure.

causes.labelEn: Low oil pressure or wrong oil viscosity

symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: B Camshaft Position Slow Response Bank 1
records.descriptionEn: The exhaust camshaft phaser on bank 1 responds too slowly to commanded position changes. Same root causes as P000A but on the exhaust cam.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: A Camshaft Position Slow Response Bank 2
records.descriptionEn: Intake camshaft phaser on bank 2 responds too slowly. Same fault pattern as P000A on the second cylinder bank.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: B Camshaft Position Slow Response Bank 2
records.descriptionEn: Exhaust camshaft phaser on bank 2 responds too slowly. Same fault pattern as P000B on the second cylinder bank.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: Fuel Volume Regulator Control Exceeded Learning Limit
records.descriptionEn: The ECU's adaptive correction of fuel volume regulator A has reached its learning limit. Indicates a long-term drift between commanded and actual rail pressure that could no longer be compensated.

records.titleEn: Fuel System Over Pressure Relief Valve Activated
records.descriptionEn: The mechanical pressure relief valve on the fuel rail has opened due to overpressure. Indicates a malfunction of the rail pressure regulation that drove pressure beyond the safe limit.

records.titleEn: "A" Camshaft Position Actuator Circuit (Bank 1)
records.descriptionEn: An electrical fault in the bank 1 intake camshaft position actuator solenoid (variable valve timing). The ECU monitors current and feedback on the oil control valve and sets this code when the circuit is open, shorted, or out of range.

causes.labelEn: Wiring or connector fault to actuator

symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: "A" Camshaft Position - Timing Over-Advanced or System Performance (Bank 1)
records.descriptionEn: The bank 1 intake camshaft is more advanced than commanded, or the actuator does not respond as expected. Often caused by stuck-open oil control valves, sludge in VVT passages, or low oil pressure.

causes.labelEn: Sludge or debris in VVT oil passages
Low engine oil pressure or wrong oil viscosity

symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: "A" Camshaft Position - Timing Over-Retarded (Bank 1)
records.descriptionEn: The bank 1 intake camshaft remains retarded compared to commanded position. Common causes include a stuck-closed oil control valve, blocked oil passages, or a worn cam phaser.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: "B" Camshaft Position Actuator Circuit (Bank 1)
records.descriptionEn: Electrical fault in the bank 1 exhaust camshaft position actuator solenoid. Same diagnostic principle as P0010 but on the exhaust cam.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: "B" Camshaft Position - Timing Over-Advanced (Bank 1)
records.descriptionEn: Exhaust camshaft position bank 1 over-advanced or system performance — the actual cam phase exceeds the commanded value. Usually caused by a stuck-open oil control valve, low oil pressure, sludged passages, or a worn cam phaser. Confirm with a scan tool live data: command 0° advance and watch actual.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: "B" Camshaft Position - Timing Over-Retarded (Bank 1)
records.descriptionEn: The bank 1 exhaust camshaft remains retarded relative to commanded position. Same root causes as P0012 but on the exhaust cam.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 1 Sensor A)
records.descriptionEn: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 1 Sensor A): the value does not correlate with the related sensor or expected pattern. This relates to engine timing; a fault can cause rough running, a no-start, or timing errors.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 1 Sensor B)
records.descriptionEn: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 1 Sensor B): the value does not correlate with the related sensor or expected pattern. This relates to engine timing; a fault can cause rough running, a no-start, or timing errors.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 2 Sensor A)
records.descriptionEn: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 2 Sensor A): the value does not correlate with the related sensor or expected pattern. This relates to engine timing; a fault can cause rough running, a no-start, or timing errors.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 2 Sensor B)
records.descriptionEn: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 2 Sensor B): the value does not correlate with the related sensor or expected pattern. This relates to engine timing; a fault can cause rough running, a no-start, or timing errors.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: A Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit/Open Bank 1
records.descriptionEn: Open circuit at the camshaft profile actuator (intake, profile A, bank 1). Used by systems with discrete cam-lift levels (e.g. BMW Valvetronic, Honda VTEC, Audi AVS) — the actuator that selects the lift profile cannot be driven.

causes.labelEn: Pin pushed back out of connector body

symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: A Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit Low Bank 1
records.descriptionEn: Low control voltage at the cam profile actuator (intake, profile A, bank 1). Typically a short to ground in the wiring or actuator coil.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: A Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit High Bank 1
records.descriptionEn: Excessively high control voltage at the cam profile actuator (intake, profile A, bank 1). Typically a short to power or open ground.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: A Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit/Open Bank 2
records.descriptionEn: Open circuit at the cam profile actuator (intake, profile A, bank 2). Same fault as P001A but on bank 2. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

causes.labelEn: Pin pushed back out of connector body

symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: A Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit Low Bank 2
records.descriptionEn: Low control voltage at the cam profile actuator (intake, profile A, bank 2). Same fault as P001B on bank 2. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: A Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit High Bank 2
records.descriptionEn: Excessively high control voltage at the cam profile actuator (intake, profile A, bank 2). Same fault as P001C on bank 2. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance
Supply wire pinched against B+ source

symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: "A" Camshaft Position Actuator Circuit (Bank 2)
records.descriptionEn: Electrical fault in the bank 2 intake camshaft position actuator. Same diagnostic principle as P0010 but on the second cylinder bank.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: "A" Camshaft Position - Timing Over-Advanced (Bank 2)
records.descriptionEn: The bank 2 intake camshaft is more advanced than commanded, or the actuator does not respond as expected. Often caused by stuck-open oil control valves, sludge in VVT passages, or low oil pressure.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: "A" Camshaft Position - Timing Over-Retarded (Bank 2)
records.descriptionEn: The bank 2 intake camshaft remains retarded compared to commanded position. Common causes include a stuck-closed oil control valve, blocked oil passages, or a worn cam phaser.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: "B" Camshaft Position Actuator Circuit (Bank 2)
records.descriptionEn: Electrical fault in the bank 2 exhaust camshaft position actuator. Same diagnostic principle as P0013 but on the second cylinder bank.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: "B" Camshaft Position - Timing Over-Advanced (Bank 2)
records.descriptionEn: The bank 2 exhaust camshaft is more advanced than commanded. Same root causes as P0011 but on the exhaust cam.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: "B" Camshaft Position - Timing Over-Retarded (Bank 2)
records.descriptionEn: The bank 2 exhaust camshaft remains retarded relative to commanded position. Same root causes as P0012 but on the exhaust cam.
symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: Intake Valve Control Solenoid Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 1)
records.descriptionEn: The ECU detected that the bank 1 intake valve oil control solenoid does not respond as expected. Common causes are sludge in the oil passages, a sticking solenoid, or low oil pressure that prevents proper VVT phasing on the intake side.

causes.labelEn: Sludge or debris in oil passages
Low oil pressure or wrong oil viscosity

records.titleEn: Exhaust Valve Control Solenoid Circuit Range/Performance Bank 1
records.descriptionEn: The ECU detects that the exhaust camshaft oil control valve on bank 1 does not respond to commanded duty cycle within expected limits. Camshaft phase deviates from target during phaser actuation tests.

causes.labelEn: Oil control valve clogged with sludge
Low oil pressure or wrong oil viscosity

records.titleEn: Intake Valve Control Solenoid Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 2)
records.descriptionEn: The ECU detected that the bank 2 intake valve oil control solenoid does not respond as expected. Common causes are sludge in the oil passages, a sticking solenoid, or low oil pressure that prevents proper VVT phasing on the intake side.

causes.labelEn: Sludge or debris in oil passages
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

records.titleEn: Exhaust Valve Control Solenoid Circuit Range/Performance Bank 2
records.descriptionEn: The ECU detects that the exhaust camshaft oil control valve on bank 2 does not respond to commanded duty cycle within expected limits. Camshaft phase deviates from target during phaser actuation tests.

causes.labelEn: Oil control valve clogged with sludge
Low oil pressure or wrong oil viscosity

records.titleEn: B Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit/Open Bank 1
records.descriptionEn: Open circuit at the cam profile actuator on the exhaust cam (profile A, bank 1). Same diagnosis as P001A but for the exhaust profile actuator.

causes.labelEn: Pin pushed back out of connector body

symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: B Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit Low Bank 1
records.descriptionEn: Low control voltage at the exhaust cam profile actuator (profile A, bank 1). Short to ground in wiring or coil.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: B Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit High Bank 1
records.descriptionEn: Excessively high control voltage at the exhaust cam profile actuator (profile A, bank 1). Short to power or open ground.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance
Supply wire pinched against B+ source

symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: B Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit/Open Bank 2
records.descriptionEn: Open circuit at the exhaust cam profile actuator (profile A, bank 2). Same as P002A on bank 2. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

causes.labelEn: Pin pushed back out of connector body
Cracked solder joint inside the module or sensor

symptomsEn: Power loss especially in mid-rpm range

records.titleEn: B Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit Low Bank 2
records.descriptionEn: Low control voltage at the exhaust cam profile actuator (profile A, bank 2). Same as P002B on bank 2. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

causes.labelEn: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance
